split_markdown_to_pages: split a markdown document into per-page paragraphs aligned with a PDF using split_markdown
train_bag_of_words: train a BagOfWords classifier on sentences with optional target labels for text classification
find_figure_locations: find figure locations in PDF pages by matching captions with find_figures
extract_pdf_text: extract text from a PDF as lines or blocks using get_doc_text with configurable splitting
clean_pdf_page_text: clean PDF page text by removing frequent header and footer words with clean_pdf_text
